description: This PHP source file defines the Origin class within the Goteo application, representing the origin or source of some data related to projects, calls, investments, and other entities. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, and listing origin records, as well as generating various statistics and saving instances.

classes.name: Origin
classes.description: Model class representing the origin or source of data associated with projects, calls, investments, and channels within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, and saving origin records, as well as generating statistics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single Origin instance by its id.

methods.name: getFromArray
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Origin instance matching the given array of key-value pairs, or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of Origin objects filtered and paginated according to provided criteria.

methods.name: getInvestsStats
methods.description: Generates statistics about investments related to origins, optionally grouped and filtered.

methods.name: getModelStats
methods.description: Generates statistical summaries of origins, grouped by tags or categories, and filtered by various criteria such as project, call, matcher, channel, user, or consultant.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current instance of Origin to the database, updating counters and timestamps.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the origin object, primarily checking for duplication or consistency before saving.
